name: SpcControlChart
tagline: X̄–R, X̄–S and I–MR control charts with Nelson rules, Cpk and assignable causes — inside Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: A statistical process control chart for manufacturing quality teams. It calculates control limits from your subgroups (or uses frozen limits), shades the sigma zones, flags Nelson rule violations, shows process capability (Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk, expected PPM) with a histogram, and lets operators and engineers record the assignable cause and corrective action for each signal. Annotations are saved in one text column. Works in Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages; React bundled, no external services.
features: X̄–R, X̄–S and I–MR charts with automatic selection by subgroup size
Calculated or fixed control limits, zones and spec limits
Nelson rules 1–8 plus spread-chart limits, with a filterable signal list
Process capability: Cp, Cpk, Pp, Ppk, σ within/overall, expected PPM, histogram
Assignable cause by 6M category, corrective action and exclude-from-limits per point
In control / out of control status, KPI tiles and Power Fx outputs
Desktop side panel, tablet stacked layout, tabbed phone layout
Keyboard navigation, ARIA live announcements, configurable texts and colours
